g.text: Three units clustered through a 5GBASE-T switch (USB 5GbE adapters)

text.tspan: CLUSTER jack (5GbE) + LAN (onboard 1 GbE or Wi-Fi 7)
4 x 10GbE RJ45 (each negotiates 5G), fanless, 25 W max
ports 1-3: one Cat6 per unit CLUSTER jack; port 4: spare (4th unit)

g.text: LAN: onboard 1 GbE jack and/or Wi-Fi 7 adapter

text.tspan: Two units default to a 1G direct Cat6 between the onboard ports; they need no switch and no 5GbE adapters.
The switch (3+ units) carries only cluster (RPC) traffic; client traffic stays on the 1 GbE LAN jacks or Wi-Fi 7.
Never run cluster traffic over Wi-Fi. Unmanaged or managed is fine. 2.5G-only switches do NOT work at 5G.
